entries_new.name: Kandla Special Economic Zone
entries_new.story:
Kandla Special Economic Zone is one of the seven special economic zones (SEZs) established by India's central government, located at Gandhidham, Kutch district, Gujarat. The Commerce Ministry says Asia's first export processing zone was set up at Kandla in 1965. The notified list records its type as "multi product", with an area of 400 hectares, notified as an SEZ on 1 November 2000. It appears on the Commerce Ministry's list of operational SEZs up to 31 March 2026.
Under India's SEZ rules, units in a zone import goods duty-free and were given income tax exemptions on export income (closed to new units from April 2020); these are concessions inside Indian law, not a separate jurisdiction.

entries_new.name: Port City Colombo
aka: Colombo Port City
Colombo Port City Special Economic Zone
entries_new.founder: Government of Sri Lanka with China Harbour Engineering Company
entries_new.laws: Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021
entries_new.story:
Port City Colombo is a multi-services special economic zone on 269 hectares of land reclaimed from the sea beside Galle Face Green in Colombo, Sri Lanka, based on a concept proposal by China Harbour Engineering Company. Reclamation was finished by January 2019. A 2021 law, the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No. 11, set up the zone and its own commission, and allowed tax exemptions of up to 40 years, with a special Colombo financial court as first court for commercial cases.
Under an IMF programme agreed between 2023 and 2025, the government suspended new tax holidays, and a September 2025 regulation shortened them to 8 to 15 years for new primary businesses. The zone remains inside Sri Lankan law, with appeals to the Supreme Court of Sri Lanka.

entries_new.name: Bhairahawa Special Economic Zone
entries_new.story:
Bhairahawa Special Economic Zone is in Rupandehi district, Nepal. Nepal's SEZ Authority says it "is in the stage of operation now". In January 2021 The Himalayan Times reported that it had still not come into full operation 20 years after its launch, because of missing infrastructure such as power lines and provisions of the SEZ Act.
Nepal's SEZ Act was introduced on 4 October 2016; firms in a zone had to export a set share of output, first 80 per cent and later 60 per cent, a condition industrialists said kept them away.

sources.t: Special Economic Zone Authority of Nepal
Bhairahawa SEZ not in full operation even after 20 years of launch, The Himalayan Times

entries_new.name: Ayla Sustainable Township
aka: Project Ayla
entries_new.story:
Ayla Sustainable Township, also called Project Ayla, is a USD 790 million development on Dhigufaru, Dhekenanfaru and Kuramaadhoo Falhu in Noonu Atoll, Maldives. It was designated a Special Economic Zone by Presidential Decree on 31 December 2025, after an SEZ permit issued on 9 December 2025 and an investment agreement between Crystal Holdings Private Limited and the Board of Investments, and is the first township under a November 2025 amendment to the SEZ Act. Ground was broken on 29 January 2026, with completion planned for 2028.
Under the Maldives' Special Economic Zones Act (Act No. 24/2014), the President sets by annual decree which activities are permitted in SEZs and the minimum investment for them.
